notes.title: [DEMO UPDATE] Language Settings Fix
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

We’ve got great news for you!

[Update Details]

 You can now properly switch languages in the settings within the demo.
[/olist]
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused in the demo.

Thank you for your continued love for Love Delivery!

notes.title: [Update] V2.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

V2.0.7 is now live!

In this update, we've made the following changes:

[Update Details]
[olist]
 Fixed issues with trademarks, copyrights, and other elements that could potentially infringe upon third-party rights.
[olist]
 Some images have been updated.
 Some sounds have been updated.
 Some text has been modified.
 Improved certain voice lines.
The full name of "Kwon Latte" has now been recorded and implemented.
Special thanks to voice actors Lee Myung-ho and Kim Hee-seung for their help in recording!
[/olist]
 Steam achievements "Honestly, getting money from mom is better" and "If you can't enjoy it, avoid it" will now unlock properly even if a save file already exists.
 Fixed an issue where the game wouldn't save if the computer's date and time format wasn't set to 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
[/olist]


We appreciate everyone who reported these issues.

Thank you for your continued love for Love Delivery!

notes.title: [Update] V2.0.5 is now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

V2.0.5 is now live!
In this update, we fixed the following issues.

[olist]
 Fixed a number of controller related issues
 Fixed an issue where players could not enter custom names.
 Fixed an issue where the Stove warning was displayed.
 Fixed an issue where the language would switch to English after restarting when set to Korean.
[/olist]

Thank you to everyone who reported these issues.

We appreciate your continued love for Love Delivery!

notes.title: [FIX] V2.0.3 Update (Achievement Issue Fixed)
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

There was an issue with Achievement in the latest build, and it is now fixed!

Thank Hadaz for the swift feedback 👍

If you find any issues along the way, please report it to us. We are more than happy to address it.


Thank you 😊
